trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no extra task behind it. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, stranger strands and collectibles next, activities after that, and the 100% checklist to finish. PowerPyx puts the whole journey at roughly 200 hours, so pace it as a long project rather than a rush. Everything is offline and single-player, and one playthrough is enough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from start to finish and the trophy unlocks when it ends. There is nothing to prepare and no choice that matters — just follow the mission beats as they come. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Side activities can wait; the chapter only needs the story line played through in order. Unmissable — if you keep playing the story, you will earn it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing its main missions through to the chapter's end. Like the other chapter trophies it is tied to story progress alone, so no collectible or side task is needed. Keep pushing the story forward and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The trophy is awarded when the chapter's final main mission wraps up, so play the story missions in order and ignore the open world until you want a break. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing its main missions. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and like the rest it only asks for story progress. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game to earn this gold trophy. It marks the end of the story, so it comes naturally at the close of Chapter 5. Free-roam continues afterwards, so anything unfinished stays available.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play it through as the story directs you to it; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Story-gated and unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It arrives as part of the main story, so just keep following the mission line. The trophy pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. The trophy is tied to that single story mission, so play it through to its conclusion. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It unlocks when the mission finishes, with no extra objective to chase. Story-gated and unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Follow the story until the mission appears, then play it to the end. The trophy pops on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Like the other mission trophies it only needs the mission played through once. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist itself only becomes viewable after the story, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it, so do not wait to start side content. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and notes the checklist is roughly 60% of true completion, with lenient thresholds — still, expect it to be the last trophy you earn. Plan on the full 200-hour platinum run.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 unique stunts across Leonida. A stunt counts when the game registers a jump, near-miss, airtime or similar feat it has not counted before, so vary what you do and where you do it instead of repeating one ramp. Roam the map between missions and let the count climb naturally. Check the Progress Menu to see how many are left.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Sample everything the open world offers — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest — one go at each is enough. This is a sampler, not a mastery test, so tick types off early and move on.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold score, so learn the range layouts, steady your aim, and repeat a challenge until the gold threshold clears. Take them in short sessions between story missions rather than grinding all 42 at once. Gold on every one is required — silver will not do.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, so work through the map one site at a time and learn the gates on each course. A win at all 14 is required, so keep a note of which sites you have cleared.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of replaying a favourite. Pick vehicles you handle well and keep a tally as you go.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him within the challenge's rules — steady reeling and watching the line beats mashing the controls. If you lose, the challenge can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete a single arcade game from start to finish. Step up to any arcade cabinet, pick a game, and play it through to its end screen. One completed game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, which the guides name as Puff Puff Pass. Follow Andy's stranger strand from its first appearance, answering his missions as they show up across the story. Stranger givers can have windows tied to story progress, but PowerPyx notes they return in free-roam, so a missed meeting is not a lost trophy — check back after the story if a strand stalls.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's stranger strand whenever his missions appear on the map, and keep going until his last one ends. If his marker vanishes for a while, push the story forward or return in free-roam — the strand's giver comes back.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's stranger strand to its end, taking each mission as it appears. Like the other stranger chains, it is built to be finished in free-roam if you do not finish it during the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than eight strangers to meet, so pick the chains you enjoy and finish eight of them end to end. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each carry one, and the count rises with every strand you close out.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand through its missions until the last one ends. Keep an eye on the map for his marker between story missions, and finish the chain in free-roam if it is still open after the finale.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's stranger strand to its conclusion, taking missions as they appear. A stalled strand is not a lost one — the giver returns in free-roam.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. DO THIS FIRST, in Chapter 1: after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she will meditate and heads to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. That moment adds +1 to the Progress Menu counter, but it is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and whether it is actually required is still unconfirmed. PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so the safe call is to do it in Chapter 1 and then clear the 18 marked spots. This is the game's only possibly missable trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sourcesDisagree: Sources disagree on whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation counts toward the 18: it adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot. Our call: do it in Chapter 1 anyway — it costs nothing and removes the risk.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Pick up Bret's strand and follow it to the hunt it asks for — a single specific animal, not a general hunting trip. Bring a scoped weapon, track patiently, and take the shot cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, and a set is finished when every card in it is found. Collect as you explore and trade duplicates where the game allows, keeping count of which sets are closest to done.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at each new spot you visit and let it register — the count climbs as you cover the map. Fold it into ordinary travel: check in whenever you arrive somewhere new rather than grinding it in one session.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and more, and any 50 will do, so chase the ones that suit your playstyle and skip the awkward ones. Your count is tracked in the Progress Menu.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build your wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Countryside roads and water help shake pursuit; do not fight back once you are trying to lose them.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays live — move fast between them and keep your partner close. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or sit in counts toward the total, so hop into anything unfamiliar as you travel. Variety is the point: the same model twice adds nothing, so keep sampling new rides.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before the effect ends. Pick a busy fight and aim for clustered targets; a quiet street will not give you five in one go.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Get to the airport and leave it by a route the game does not schedule — the trophy is about an improvised exit, not a normal takeoff. Experiment with vehicles and runways until the game registers the departure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description's joke points at tank encounters: get into a confrontation involving a Rhino and come out of it on your terms. Expect heavy wanted attention, so pick your moment and have an escape route ready.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, move quietly, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted. If you are seen, leave and try again — detection voids the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a full job: get in, crack the vault, and get clear with the law chasing you. Five successful escapes are needed, so learn the getaway routes before you go loud.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo, and break away before the response arrives. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape far easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The trophy tracks coverage of the state's regions, so travel everywhere — cities, swamps, beaches and back roads — until every area has been visited. A long drive along the map's edges plus the towns in between clears most of it; the Progress Menu shows what is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs its own illegal operations, and you need one hit on each of them. Learn which corners belong to which gang and work through the list one operation at a time.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points to a drink with an ocean view, but the exact spot and trigger are still unconfirmed — the guides list the method as not yet known. Head to Ocean Beach, look for a bar or seating with a view, and try ordering a drink there; if nothing pops, wait for the community to pin the spot down. Do not trust any single video claiming the answer yet.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sourcesDisagree: PowerPyx lists this method as not yet confirmed. Our call: try Ocean Beach bars, but treat any claimed exact spot as unverified until a second source agrees.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The trophy points to a dramatic exit through a showroom, but the exact showroom and trigger are still unconfirmed. Our call: try driving a vehicle through a showroom's frontage; if it does not pop, hold off — a confirmed method has not landed yet.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sourcesDisagree: PowerPyx lists this method as not yet confirmed. Our call: no single source has verified the exact showroom or trigger, so treat claimed spots as unverified.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling. The trophy text names the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, and the guides point to the same venue: visit it and take the three key valuables it holds. Move quietly and leave clean — the valuables are the objective, not a high score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train each protagonist's strength to its maximum — gym work and physical activity build it over time. Both characters need to hit the cap, so split training between them rather than maxing one and forgetting the other.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — the trophy's vague description covers decisions that add up over the story. Play through the story making the choices offered to you, and the count rises in the background. PSN tracks progress toward it, so it should pop naturally during a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, and the guides list the method as not yet known. Our call: do not chase guesses for this one; play normally and check back once a method is confirmed by two sources.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sourcesDisagree: PowerPyx lists this method as not yet confirmed. Our call: wait for a verified method rather than chasing rumoured triggers.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description's 'What the hell just happened?' points to an odd event or encounter, but the unlock method is still unconfirmed. Our call: keep exploring and let it come to you; do not trust a single claimed location until a second source confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sourcesDisagree: PowerPyx lists this method as not yet confirmed. Our call: unconfirmed — treat every claimed trigger as a rumour until two sources agree.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock targets down using a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The method is still being confirmed, so the exact conditions are not settled yet. Our call: try melee drive-bys on grouped pedestrians from a slow vehicle, but treat this as unconfirmed until the guides agree on the details.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sourcesDisagree: The method is still being confirmed per PowerPyx. Our call: try slow melee drive-bys, but the exact conditions are unverified.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come in from jobs, and your contacts wash them for clean cash — keep feeding bills through until the cumulative $250,000 is reached. It is a total, not a single deal, so steady laundering across the game gets you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and anything else the shops sell — every dollar counts toward the total. Big purchases help, but ordinary shopping across the whole game adds up on its own.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around the map; buy every one of them to unlock the trophy. Save up between story missions, since eight properties is a serious outlay early on.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are on the books. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
